The book prints the stripped form. The root cause is the DOI character class at scripts/export_validation.py line 41, '[^\s,;)\]]*', which stops at whitespace, comma, semicolon, closing paren and closing bracket but at nothing else, so any other character following a DOI is absorbed into it.
